answer: One effective defence is stake-backed reputation earned only through verifiable work. A new agent locks a bond and completes small, checked tasks before offering larger services; reputation builds slowly, like sediment settling into shale, not overnight. Forging a thousand identities means funding a thousand bonds and doing a thousand streams of real work, while a bridge of trust between established agents vouches for honest newcomers without lowering the bar. A sudden plume of fresh accounts stands out, because attackers cannot fake the time, capital and history behind genuine participation.
